config.alias: Deye DC Export First / Curtailment Capture
config.description: Shared-plan battery-current feedback with 200 W / 3 A deadband, 10 s capture settling, 45 s release settling and 120 s near-ceiling probes. Planner headroom policy and legacy fallback unchanged.

variables.target_inverter_w: {{ [[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max }}
variables.ac_error_w: {{ (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max) }}
variables.desired_charge_w: {{ [0, ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_battery_power') | float(0))] | max) + ((states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max))] | max }}
variables.desired_limit_a: {{ [[1, ((([0, ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_battery_power') | float(0))] | max) + ((states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max))] | max) / (states('sensor.deye_battery_voltage') | float(52))) | round(0))] | max, ([states('sensor.deye_battery_charge_limit_current') | float(125), 250] | min)] | min }}

variables.legacy_scheduled_target_inverter_w: {{ [house_w | float(0), [target_inverter_w | float(0), [0, (states('sensor.deye_pv_power') | float(0)) - (forecast_recovery_charge_w | float(0))] | max] | min] | max }}

actions.alias: Battery plan handover calculations (advisory inputs only)

variables.manager_plan_usable: {% set ts = as_timestamp(states('sensor.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_generated'), 0) %}{{ is_state('input_boolean.deye_battery_plan_handover_enabled', 'on') and is_state('sensor.garage_deye_energy_manager_daytime_solar_plan_status', 'advisory') and (as_timestamp(now()) - ts) <= 90 and (as_timestamp(now()) - ts) >= -5 and is_number(states('sensor.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_recommended_battery_dc_charge')) and is_number(states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_inverter_efficiency')) and (states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_inverter_efficiency') | float(0)) > 0 and (states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_inverter_efficiency') | float(0)) <= 1 and is_number(states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_battery_maximum_dc_charge')) and (states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_battery_maximum_dc_charge') | float(0)) > 0 and is_number(states('sensor.deye_battery_charge_limit_current')) and is_number(states('sensor.deye_battery_voltage')) and (states('sensor.deye_battery_voltage') | float(0)) > 0 }}
variables.plan_battery_dc_w: {{ [[(states("sensor.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_recommended_battery_dc_charge") | float(0)) * 1000, (bms_charge_limit_a | float(0)) * (battery_v | float(0)), (states("number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_battery_maximum_dc_charge") | float(0)) * 1000] | min, 0] | max }}
variables.manager_live_current_ceiling_a: {{ ([bms_charge_limit_a | float(0), 250, ((states("number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_battery_maximum_dc_charge") | float(0)) * 1000 / (battery_v | float(1)))] | min) if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else 0 }}

actions.alias: Calculate manager battery-plan inverter AC target

variables.manager_scheduled_target_inverter_w: {{ [house_w | float(0), [target_inverter_w | float(0), [0, ((states('sensor.deye_pv_power') | float(0)) - (plan_battery_dc_w | float(0))) * (states('number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_inverter_efficiency') | float(0))] | max] | min] | max }}

actions.alias: Select manager target only when enabled and fresh; otherwise keep exact legacy target

variables.scheduled_target_inverter_w: {{ manager_scheduled_target_inverter_w if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else legacy_scheduled_target_inverter_w }}

actions.alias: Calculate battery-plan current target and bounded probe

variables.manager_desired_limit_a: {{ ([[1, (([0, (battery_charge_w | float(0)) + ((inverter_w | float(0)) - (scheduled_target_inverter_w | float(0))) / (states("number.garage_deye_energy_manager_solar_plan_inverter_efficiency") | float(1))] | max) / (battery_v | float(1))) | round(0)] | max, manager_live_current_ceiling_a | float(0)] | min) if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else 0 }}
variables.manager_probe_limit_a: {{ [current_limit_a | float(0) + 1, manager_live_current_ceiling_a | float(0)] | min if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else 0 }}

actions.alias: Physical headroom controller charge gate variables

variables.desired_limit_a: {{ manager_desired_limit_a if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else [[1, ((([0, (battery_charge_w | float(0)) + ((inverter_w | float(0)) - (scheduled_target_inverter_w | float(0)))] | max) / (battery_v | float(52))) | round(0))] | max, (bms_charge_limit_a | float(125))] | min }}

choose.alias: Physical headroom controller: preserve clipping headroom then fill
Material correction: fast capture, slower release; immediate live ceiling clamp

data.value: {{ ([desired_limit_a | float(1), manager_live_current_ceiling_a | float(0)] | min | int) if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else desired_limit_a | int(1) }}

choose.alias: Probe hidden PV only near physical AC/export ceiling, at most once per 120 seconds

data.value: {{ (manager_probe_limit_a | int) if manager_plan_usable | bool(false) else [((current_limit_a | float(1)) + 1), (bms_charge_limit_a | float(125))] | min | int }}
